title: Small independent error probabilities accumulate
unit: percent with at least one failure
method: Illustrative probability model: 100 × [1 − (1 − 0.001)^N], rounded to two decimals, for N=100, 500, 1,000. Assumes independent identical failures. This is not quantum-device measurement, a logical error model, or a forecast.
alt: Small independent error probabilities accumulate. 100 operations: 9.52 percent with at least one failure, 500 operations: 39.36 percent with at least one failure, 1,000 operations: 63.23 percent with at least one failure. Illustrative data.
